rationale: Removed all references to the deleted `Entity.name` field in both construction and read operations. The `process_entity` function no longer includes `name` in the output fields for v1, and entity creation no longer sets a name when version is v1.
assumptions: The generated bindings will handle the reserved field correctly without requiring explicit handling of field number 2 or the name string.
No other implicit references to `name` exist in the codebase beyond these two sites.
